name: spreadsheets
description: Real spreadsheet production: formatted XLSX workbooks, charts and tabular evaluations.

commands.name: xlsx
commands.template: Create a real Excel workbook for: {input}. Use create_xlsx (and generate_chart where useful) with formatted headers and clear columns.

commands.name: model
commands.template: Build a spreadsheet model for: {input}. Separate inputs, assumptions and outputs; show formulas and one sensitivity table; state every assumption.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Clean a table and keep the raw copy
commands.template: Clean the table described by: {input}. Normalize headers, types and dates, list every changed row and keep an untouched copy.

changelog: 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
